accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure text-to-background contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds where text needs to be readable.

media.image_handling: Images should have max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none. Overlays must not exceed bg-black/50 opacity.

css_variables_update.instructions: Ensure global CSS uses border-radius of max 8px (0.5rem) for a more dense, dashboard-appropriate layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: RESTRUCTURE NAVIGATION: In the sidebar and main navigation routes, remove all 10 old marketing subcategories. Keep ONLY two categories under Marketing: 'Agente · Site' and 'Agente · Redes Sociais'.
RESTRUCTURE /MARKETING PAGE: The marketing landing page should be visually split into 2 main blocks. Block 1: 'Agente · Site'. Block 2: 'Agente · Redes Sociais'.
CONTENT ALLOCATION - AGENTE SITE: Place the following 3 categories strictly inside the 'Agente · Site' block, in this exact order: 'Estratégia' → 'Gateway' → 'SEO/GA4/GSC'.

CONTENT ALLOCATION - AGENTE REDES SOCIAIS: Place the following 6 categories strictly inside the 'Agente · Redes Sociais' block, in this exact order: 'Automação' → 'Meta' → 'Marca & Conteúdo' → 'Campanhas' → 'Aprovação & Calendário' → 'Operação & Resultados'.
COMPACT BLOCKS: Make the internal sections within each agent more compact. Use shorter titles and summaries. Avoid excessive padding; use dense layouts suitable for an admin dashboard.
Do not break any existing testids or routes. If subpages exist, link them correctly from inside the new dense bento blocks.
Ensure the layout doesn't use massive, spaced-out cards but rather a cohesive 'bento grid' approach where 'Agente · Site' and 'Agente · Redes Sociais' are the primary visual containers.
Do not use generic center alignment. Keep dense tabular/data content left-aligned.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable, EXCEPT for data-dense tables/dashboards where compact B-mode grids are required.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
